sources.title: changeindream/oscc-pni-mil-checkpoints · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: OSCC PNI patient-level MIL checkpoints Inference-only PyTorch state dictionaries for the OSCC PNI research demonstration. The collection includes Swin Transformer MIL, Vision Transformer MIL, DenseNet-121 MIL, and the currently supplied ResNet checkpoint. Training optimizer states were removed without quantization. manifest.json records SHA-256 checksums of the original training checkpoints ...
